headline: Entel Posts Q3 2026 Revenue Beat as Stock Edges Higher
summary: Entel reported a third-quarter 2026 revenue beat, sending its stock slightly higher following the earnings release.
why: Quarterly revenue reports provide core visibility into telecommunications operators' top-line growth and subscriber monetization trends.

impacts.name: Entel
impacts.why: A revenue beat positively influenced investor sentiment and edged the stock higher.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Better-than-expected revenue figures for the third quarter drove positive investor sentiment, lifting the stock price.
